plainText:
----
 
 
Dominic (Chinese: 大明 Da Ming) is a main character in The Journey of One Dream. He is the father of Vin and has a large collection of Pokémon video games.

==History==
 
In the past, Dominic was a child who grew up playing Pokémon games, eventually coming to own copies of , , , , , , and . Over the years, he became an adult who lived only for work, without being able to pay attention to his family.

One day, his son Vin mysteriously managed to enter the world of games and interacted with several versions of himself that were present in the games. This version of Dominic, who calls himself Lord Dominic (Chinese: 鼎鼎大明 Dominic the Great), became friends with Vin, which made him enter more and more games. During a break in his work, Dominic discovers that his son was inside his Pokémon Ultra Moon cartridge, and he immediately went after him to save him.

After saving his son, the two accidentally went on an Ultra Warp Ride and landed in Ultra Space Wilds, where they encountered a . During the battle, Dominic was forced to use all of his Pokémon in hand and was still defeated, causing him to use Mega Evolution on his . In order to have a chance of victory, Vin reminded him to use his secret technique involving the move . With the help of his son and , Vin and Dominic managed to escape and return to the real world.

After celebrating their battle, Dominic returned to his work, but Vin notices that something has changed about him. In the epilogue, inside two Nintendo Switch consoles with Pokémon Sword and Shield, Dominic and Vin are participating side by side, as Lord Dominic and Vin the Invincible, in a Pokémon battle against two Trainers.
